boons.name: FIELD REFIT
boons.canon: A Human salvage charter makes the first duplicate systems cheap enough to standardize.

boons.name: LAST OF THE LINE
boons.canon: A defense charter converts existential pressure into concentrated combat output.

boons.name: SALVAGE RIGHTS
boons.canon: A legal-industrial regime allows rapid sale, reuse, and ascension of captured systems.

boons.name: HARD POINTS
boons.canon: A Human foothold learns to survive Vigil disruption through redundant physical infrastructure.

boons.name: INTEGRATION
boons.canon: The decisive Human reward is broader doctrine, not a single alien superweapon.

boons.name: THE LONG WATCH
boons.canon: A standing Accord relief network restores defensive depth after each survived wave.

boons.name: THE OATH
boons.canon: A precisely scoped survival vow allows one otherwise lethal breach to be absorbed.

boons.name: RELIQUARY
boons.canon: Collective memory makes repeated ascension cheaper and more meaningful.

boons.name: AUREOLE
boons.canon: Authenticated support fields extend farther and make status effects more coherent.

boons.name: ETERNAL SERVICE
boons.canon: A deliberately controversial continuation charter strengthens echoes while exposing the danger of consent without end dates.

boons.name: DIGESTION
boons.canon: Each death increases the local efficiency of Compact extraction.

boons.name: CARAPACE
boons.canon: A repeatedly harvested system evolves resistance to enemy mustering.

boons.name: RENDERING
boons.canon: Matter, damage, death, and currency are processed through one extraction economy.

boons.name: BROODSWELL
boons.canon: A local brood converts surplus mass into heavier summoned bodies.

boons.name: TOTAL CONSUMPTION
boons.canon: The Compact identifies the largest surviving assets as the highest-value Yield.

boons.name: PLUNDER
boons.canon: A route network redirects value before any state can tax or reclaim it.

boons.name: SCUTTLE
boons.canon: Pirate law treats fixed assets as temporary and rewards rapid liquidation.

boons.name: CONTRABAND
boons.canon: Unofficial supply chains make repetition cheaper than lawful procurement allows.

boons.name: THE DARK ANSWERS
boons.canon: Pirate navigators exploit Vigil timing and swarm paths without truly commanding them.

boons.name: LETTERS OF MARQUE
boons.canon: Unrecognized authority becomes real when enough armed parties honor it.
